tasks.label: Smoke test (HTTP)
args: $urls = 'http://localhost:3000/','http://localhost:3000/auth/signin','http://localhost:3000/api/health','http://localhost:3000/api/status','http://localhost:3000/designs'; foreach ($u in $urls) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $u -Method GET; Write-Output ("$u`t$($r.StatusCode)") } catch { Write-Output ("$u`tFAILED: $($_.Exception.Message)") } }
